nurse.text: Dia duit, and welcome to the Dublin Sanctuary. That's 'God be with you', which is how we say hello. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right so. Sit down, have a biscuit, and don't mind the rain. It stops. Occasionally.
There you go. Go raibh maith agat for waiting, that's 'thanks' in Irish. Mind the cobbles, they've got opinions.
The Ark terminal. It runs on turf, tea and a very patient intern.

else.text: No bother. Come in out of the wet, there's a hundred thousand welcomes, but only one chair.
